visual_review.method: PDF pages 4, 8 and 9 rendered and read (the TSE diploma, declaration of posse and termo, the signed termo); the opening (page 3) and Lula's address (pages 10-15) read from the text layer. CLAUDE-C01-17 (br_vice_president rows): PDF pages 3 (Mesa and opening), 5 (the Vice-President's TSE diploma, printed sideways), 7 (his oath and signed termo de compromisso) and 9 (signed termo de posse) rendered and read; pages 8 (declaration and typed termo) and 10 (salutation) read from the text layer.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Lula and José Alencar were re-elected on 29 October 2006; the reproduced TSE diploma says Lula, candidate of the A Força do Povo coalition (PT, PRB, PC do B), was re-elected President of the Republic by the will expressed at the polls on 29 October 2006.

locator.section: Opening declaration by Renan Calheiros; diploma on p. 4; termo on p. 8

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 14 December 2006 and signed by Minister Marco Aurélio as President of the Court, qualifies Lula for a new investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 2007; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 14 December 2006.

locator.section: Facsimile of the TSE diploma (printed sideways): "Brasília, quatorze de dezembro de dois mil e seis"

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2007 (opened 16:15 in the Chamber plenary), Lula, seated on the Mesa as President of the Republic, recited the constitutional commitment before the Congress.

locator.section: "O SR. LUIZ INÁCIO LULA DA SILVA - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."; compromisso facsimile follows

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Renan Calheiros declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 2007 to 31 December 2010; the session was opened to give posse to the two, re-elected and diplomados for the period beginning on that date.

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2007 a 31 de dezembro de 2010"; opening on p. 3

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse records that at 16:00 on 1 January 2007, before the National Congress in solemn joint session, Lula was solemnly empossado as President of the Republic under article 78 of the Constitution, re-elected on 29 October 2006 and diplomado by the TSE on 14 December 2006, for the period 1 January 2007 to 31 December 2010.

locator.section: Termo read (both columns); signed facsimile on p. 9

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address to the session Lula says he was brought back to the Presidency by the majority will of the people and speaks of "this inaugural day of my new mandate".

locator.section: Lula's address, left column ("Neste dia inaugural de meu novo mandato"); p. 14 ("fui reconduzido à Presidência da República")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address at the 2007 posse session Lula says that four years earlier, 'nesta Casa, em um 1º de janeiro', he lived the most important experience of his life, 'a de assumir a Presidência do meu País'.

locator.section: Lula's address after the salutation ('Quatro anos atrás, nesta Casa, em um 1º de janeiro, vivi a experiência mais importante de minha vida: a de assumir a Presidência do meu País')

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the opening of the solemn joint session of 1 January 2007 (16:15), the Mesa composition places "o Vice-Presidente da República, Senhor José Alencar Gomes da Silva" at the left of the Congress President.

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that Lula and José Alencar Gomes da Silva were re-elected on 29 October 2006; the reproduced TSE diploma says José Alencar Gomes da Silva, candidate of the A Força do Povo coalition (PT, PRB, PC do B), was re-elected Vice-President of the Republic by the will expressed at the polls on 29 October 2006.

locator.section: Opening by Renan Calheiros ("reeleitos em 29 de outubro de 2006"); diploma on p. 5; termo on p. 8

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The reproduced TSE diploma, dated Brasília 14 December 2006 and signed by Minister Marco Aurélio as President of the Court, qualifies José Alencar Gomes da Silva for a new investiture in the office of Vice-President before the National Congress on 1 January 2007; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 14 December 2006.

locator.section: Facsimile of the Vice-President's TSE diploma, printed sideways ("Brasília, quatorze de dezembro de dois mil e seis")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: After Lula, José Alencar Gomes da Silva recited the constitutional commitment before the Congress; the record reproduces his signed termo de compromisso under article 78, "prestado em 1º de janeiro de 2007", naming him as re-elected to the office of Vice-President of the Republic on 29 October 2006.

locator.section: "O SR. JOSÉ ALENCAR GOMES DA SILVA - Prometo manter..."; boxed facsimile "TERMO DE COMPROMISSO ... PRESTADO EM 1º DE JANEIRO DE 2007"

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Renan Calheiros declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil respectively, for the period 1 January 2007 to 31 December 2010; the session was opened to give posse to the two, re-elected and diplomados "para o período a iniciar-se nesta data".

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil, respectivamente, ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2007 a 31 de dezembro de 2010"; opening on p. 3

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The joint termo de posse records that at 16:00 on 1 January 2007, before the National Congress in solemn joint session, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President respectively, re-elected on 29 October 2006 and diplomados on 14 December 2006, for the period 1 January 2007 to 31 December 2010.

locator.section: Typed termo (both columns); signed facsimile on p. 9

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Opening his address after the posse, Lula salutes "Exmo. Sr. José Alencar, Vice-Presidente da República", and later says that he has at his side, as in 2003, José Alencar, whose collaboration eased the tasks of the past four years, and that it will be so in the government now beginning.

locator.section: Salutation of Lula's address; the passage "Tenho ao meu lado, como em 2003, o amigo e companheiro José Alencar" follows on the same page
